events.article: Gaius Maximus Valerius has begun recruiting armed men for a private expedition against robbers whose depredations have been reported in the countryside around his estates. Notices and word carried through neighboring farms have brought in laborers and other men accustomed to country life, while several recruits are said to have previous experience with horses or weapons. Payment, food, and equipment are understood to be provided from the Valerius household, rather than through a public levy. The gathering has therefore drawn particular attention among neighboring landowners, whose own estates have been affected by reports of theft. Valerius has not announced a date for the force to depart, but preparations at his estate are already plainly visible. Those following the matter locally regard the undertaking chiefly as an effort to secure property and the roads used by the surrounding estates.
